part1-mod-over-file.desc: Verifies that a folder module uses the `mod.rs` form (not the sibling-file form).
part1-mod-over-file.rationale: I don't know about this one, but we have to make one choice of the two, and I think I want everything related to the folder inside the folder.

part2-mod-location.desc: Verifies that `mod` statements appear only in `mod.rs` and `lib.rs` files.
part2-mod-location.rationale: We want consistent locations for all module declarations.

part3-mod-lib-contents.desc: Verifies that every `mod.rs` and `lib.rs` file contains only `mod` and `use` statements.
part3-mod-lib-contents.rationale: Having logic in these files makes reasoning about the module structure more difficult.

part4-use-privacy.desc: Verifies that every `use` statement in a non-`mod.rs`/`lib.rs` file is private.
part4-use-privacy.rationale: Want re-exports in the module-declaring files (`mod.rs`/`lib.rs`), which define each folder's public surface.
